model.title: No Fentanyl on Social Media Act
model.meta: Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee · Sen. Jon Husted (R-OH)

summary.text: The bill would require the Federal Trade Commission to investigate and report to Congress on how easily minors can obtain fentanyl through social media platforms, and to recommend ways to prevent such access.
